## 0. Setup

```r
library(dplyr)
library(survey)     # MEPS is a complex survey: use its weights, strata and PSUs
library(MatchIt)    # propensity score matching
library(WeightIt)   # IPTW
library(cobalt)     # balance diagnostics and love plot
library(gtsummary)  # Table 1
library(sandwich)
```
